How Attention Works

The transformer architecture replaced recurrence with attention, letting every token look at every other token in a single step.

Attention scores are computed from queries and keys, and the resulting weights are used to blend the values.

Why it matters

  • Training can be parallelised across the whole sequence.
  • Long-range dependencies are captured without vanishing gradients.
  • Scaling the model keeps improving quality.

Comparison

ArchitectureParallel training
Recurrent networkNot possible
TransformerFully parallel
Attention is all you need.
